_note: What the settings screen (#93, the gear on the title screen) may change. It saves only these keys, only changed from game_config.json, to config/local_settings.json (not in Git); the game and the backend read that file over game_config.json and ignore any key or value not allowed here (a hand-edited file cannot change the calibration or the safety settings). Types: bool, enum (options: [value, label]), number (min, max, step), text (max_length). Changes are used from the next start (the game and the backend).
